signatures.title: Signatures
signatures.subtitle: Upload PNG signatures here. Per-page placement and coordinates live on the «Signatures» tab inside each document.
signatures.noSlots: This template has no signature slots.
signatures.howItWorksItem1: Here are just the PNG files themselves. One PNG per project, reused by all documents.
signatures.howItWorksItem2: Position, page and size are configured individually on the «Signatures» tab inside each document (with PDF preview + drag/resize).
signatures.howItWorksItem3: The signature is applied to the final PDF on export to the pack or when downloading via the «With signatures» button in the document preview.

projectChecks.title: Checks for this project
projectChecks.subtitle: Disabling rules and lowering severities apply to all project documents. A document can override these settings.

requirements.title: Requirements traceability
requirements.subtitle: Coverage map: which TZ requirements are mentioned in the rest of the document set. Scans the source .tex files and links \req definitions with \reqref references.
requirements.step1Text: Define the requirement in the TZ text:
requirements.step2Text: Reference it in the VKR / PMI / TP / RP:
requirements.step3Text: Rebuild the document with the «Build» button — the matrix updates automatically.
requirements.legendOk: defined in the TZ and mentioned in at least one document.
requirements.legendWarn: defined in the TZ, but no \reqref references to it — the requirement «hangs» in the air.
requirements.legendErr: there is a \reqref reference, but no \req in the TZ — a broken or deleted entry.
requirements.howItWorksIntroSuffix: files in the project and matches requirement definitions from the TZ with references to them in the rest of the document set. Nothing to configure — the links are built from the macros.
requirements.macrosNoteSuffix: are already declared in the template preamble (
requirements.macrosNoteAfterPreamble: ). You can reference several requirements at once:
requirements.loadError: Failed to fetch the requirements matrix: {{error}}
requirements.emptyHint: Add the first requirement using the steps above — after a rebuild it will appear here.

requirementsFormat.kindMacroHint: \req{ID}{text} definitions in the TZ and \reqref{ID} references in the other documents.
requirementsFormat.kindIdHint: IDs matching the regex in source documents = definitions; the same IDs in other documents = references. For tables like «ТЗ-Ф-01 & …».
requirementsFormat.kindCustomHint: Full control: def_pattern with a (?P<id>…) group and an optional (?P<title>…); ref_pattern with a (?P<ids>…) group.
requirementsFormat.askAiTitle: The AI assistant will study the sources, pick and apply a detection format

pack.noSubmissions: No submissions yet — click «Pack» to create the first one.
pack.packAuthorHint: The package will include the selected author's personal documents, the project's shared documents, and the questionnaires this checkpoint requires from them.
pack.preflightFailed: Failed to check the package's custom documents

customFilesModal.title: Custom documents in the package
customFilesModal.description: The package includes documents replaced with your own files. Decide whether to convert the convertible formats to PDF before packaging.
customFilesModal.unknownFormatNote: Format not recognized — will be included in the package as-is, with no conversion.

projectSettings.title: Project settings
projectSettings.subtitle: Settings for this project. Stored in .hse-studio/project.json.
projectSettings.academicSupervisorHint: If unset, the default SE programme supervisor is printed
projectSettings.author: Author {{number}}
projectSettings.name: Name
projectSettings.workLanguageHint: Language of the content and file names. Set at creation. The interface language is in the app header.
projectSettings.ndaHint: Attaches the template's NDA documents to the project and the final pack.
projectSettings.ndaNoTemplateDocs: This template has no ready NDA documents — add your own files to the project folder.
projectSettings.ndaDocsAdded: NDA documents added to the project and the final pack.
projectSettings.ndaRemovedFilesKept: NDA removed, documents kept — they will return when re-enabled.
projectSettings.docSetTeamHint: Each author has their own document set — pick the author's tab. The “Shared” tab sets the default for everyone.
projectSettings.docFormatsHint: The files of every variant stay in the project — switching deletes nothing. After changing the format, rebuild the document.
projectSettings.fontsHint: Applied to every document on each build. A missing font falls back to a free metric-compatible clone; install your own in Settings → Fonts.
projectSettings.metaRequiredForSubmission: Fill in before packaging the submission.
projectSettings.archiveProjectHint: Hides it from active projects, keeps it on disk.
projectSettings.unlinkFromFolderHint: The files stay, the project disappears from the HSE Studio list.
projectSettings.ndaConfirmDescription: The project has NDA documents. If you keep them, they will return when NDA is re-enabled; if you delete them, they will be erased permanently.
projectSettings.authorManagedHint: This author's personal document set is scaffolded and maintained by the app. The author can't be removed while the set is managed.
projectSettings.authorUnmanagedHint: This author's personal document set is not managed by the app.
projectSettings.metaTeamHint: Each document block has its own metadata. The “Shared documents” tab holds the values for the shared documents and the defaults for every author; on an author's tab any field can be overridden — it applies to that author's set only (ESPD codes, thesis title page, etc.).
projectSettings.sharedDocsHint: Documents shared by the whole team (e.g. the shared technical specification) in the shared/ folder
projectSettings.authorManagedToggleHint: This author's set is managed here. Click to disable: files stay on disk, documents are unregistered (reversible).
projectSettings.authorUnmanagedToggleHint: This author's set is not managed. Click to enable: the author's folder is materialised from the template (existing files are never overwritten).
projectSettings.sharedDocsToggleOffHint: Click to disable shared documents: files stay on disk, documents are unregistered (reversible).
projectSettings.sharedDocsToggleOnHint: Click to enable shared documents: the shared/ folder is materialised from the template if missing.

files.editorHint: Select a file in the tree on the left to open it in the editor. Check findings are shown directly in the code for any project file.
files.binaryHint: This is a binary file or one unsupported for text editing. Open it in an external editor or preview.
files.generatedReadOnly: This file is generated automatically from the project settings before every build

versions.title: Change history
versions.subtitle: All edits are saved automatically. Save important versions so you can return to them at any time — it is safe. Stored separately from submission packaging.
versions.restoreDone: Done — returned to the selected version
versions.restoreError: Failed to return to the version
versions.unavailableHint: The project folder is currently inaccessible (as for building). History will become available once the folder is accessible again.
versions.notEnabledHint: Enable change history — after that, edits will start saving automatically and you will be able to return to past versions. Stored locally, next to the project.
versions.saveVersionHint: All edits are already saved automatically. Give the version a name to easily find and return to it later. Last saved: {{when}}.
versions.noNamedVersions: No saved versions yet. Click «Save version» to mark an important moment.

form.subtitle: The form fields are defined by the template pack. The document is generated automatically from your answers.
form.notFound: Form not found in this project's pack.
